what: ROOT part 2: the calculation book_totals on one trade day

columns.what: Size added on the bid side so far in the trade day: new orders, orders made larger, and size put back on an order as it traded.
Size pulled from the bid side so far: cancels, and orders made smaller.
Size of resting bid orders filled (traded away) so far, by the tape's fill messages, counted on the row where the book shows it.
Size carried by bid orders from one price to another so far. In neither added nor pulled.
Of the size added: the part at the best bid price (for a new order, best just after its tick; for an order already resting there, best just before).
Of the size pulled: the part whose price was the best bid just before its tick.
Of the size filled: the part whose price was the best bid just before its tick.
Of the size moved: the part that left the best bid price (best just before its tick).
Of the size moved: the part that joined the best bid price (best just after its tick).
Of the size added: size put back on an order in the same exchange event that filled it, so the book showed less change than the fill, or none.
Of the size refilled: the part at the best bid price.
Of the size filled: the part whose fill message the tape gives no side for.
Size added on the ask side so far in the trade day: new orders, orders made larger, and size put back on an order as it traded.
Size pulled from the ask side so far: cancels, and orders made smaller.
Size of resting ask orders filled (traded away) so far, by the tape's fill messages, counted on the row where the book shows it.
Size carried by ask orders from one price to another so far. In neither added nor pulled.
Of the size added: the part at the best ask price (for a new order, best just after its tick; for an order already resting there, best just before).
Of the size pulled: the part whose price was the best ask just before its tick.
Of the size filled: the part whose price was the best ask just before its tick.
Of the size moved: the part that left the best ask price (best just before its tick).
Of the size moved: the part that joined the best ask price (best just after its tick).
Of the size added: size put back on an order in the same exchange event that filled it, so the book showed less change than the fill, or none.
Of the size refilled: the part at the best ask price.
Of the size filled: the part whose fill message the tape gives no side for.

recount.method: whole-column recount from the stored rows, with the best price taken from the count of better levels; the foundation's total sizes; the fill messages. Shares no code with the tick-by-tick calculation

playback.cut_at: inside an exchange event, after a fill message and before the row where the book shows it

rows_gate.what: the stored-rows gate passed exactly the positions of tape.for_calculations() for this trade day

empty_cells: stored as empty (null): never 0, never blank text; a calculation skips them
